name: k8s-checks
title: Kubernetes Checks
description: Read-only checks on the Kubernetes environments in the script-commands repo's .env: how each canary went, and when each Secret last changed.
author: rezakargar

commands.name: canary-status
commands.title: Canary Status
commands.subtitle: Kubernetes
commands.description: Shows the Rollout, analysis, recent events and /errorz per environment, refreshing while open.

commands.name: secret-last-changed
commands.title: Secret Last Changed
commands.subtitle: Kubernetes
commands.description: Shows when each environment's Secret last changed, how long ago, and which manager wrote it. Reads only metadata, never the values.

preferences.name: envFile
preferences.title: .env File
preferences.description: The script-commands repo's .env, which holds the contexts, namespace, Rollout and Secret names, and canary thresholds (see .env.example).
